title: DC-area forecast: Heating up today. Storm chances trend higher again this week.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: With plenty of sun, afternoon highs reach the low to mid-90s as heat indexes top out near 100. Take it easy if spending any length of time outdoors!

What’s next? Staying hot and humid Monday and Tuesday as the chance for isolated to scattered storms makes a comeback. Could be a little cooler midweek but with potential for a few strong to severe storms.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Stuck in the dog days of summer with heat and high humidity, although we get a brief break from significant storm chances today. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): You'll need the water bottle, sunscreen, and sunglasses today. Most of the day features mostly sunny skies with highs in the low to mid-90s. Humidity may come down a bit in the afternoon, but dew points mostly in the upper 60s to low 70s are still high enough for steamy heat index values reaching the upper 90s to low 100s. Only a slight chance of an afternoon shower or storm. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: An isolated evening shower or storm is possible. Otherwise we're left with a warm and muggy night. Lows fall into the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): We're still in what is typically the peak of summer, so no surprise it's another hot and humid one. Partly to mostly sunny as highs head for the low to mid-90s again, with isolated to scattered showers and storms possible mid- to late afternoon. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: A nearby disturbance keeps the chance for isolated to scattered showers and storms going into the evening. Overnight lows in the low to mid-70s with partly cloudy skies. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

There's not much of a change in the forecast for Tuesday. Skies should be partly to mostly sunny with highs in the upper 80s to mid-90s and still humid. Radar could light up during the afternoon to evening with isolated to scattered showers or thunderstorms. Confidence: Medium

Wednesday and Thursday shouldn't be quite as hot, with highs looking like the mid-80s to near 90, and humidity may come down a little by Thursday. Scattered late-day showers and storms are possible both days, with a growing chance of a few strong to severe storms as a cold front approaches. Confidence: Low-Medium

Far from certain, but it's possible the front comes through and knocks humidity down (yay!) for Friday and the weekend with cooler highs in the 80s.

DC weather history for August 9

A brutal 1930 heat wave and historic drought brought triple-digit temperatures and parched rivers, marking one of the most severe dry spells ever observed in the region.
